connector.name: Oxcode
connector.registryDescription: PageRank-curated code intelligence for coding agents over an indexed source repository.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package oxcode-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the snowmead account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OXCODE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE
env.description: Set to 1 to disable the binary's startup self-update check (CI, offline, or reproducible environments).

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional: used during self-update to avoid unauthenticated GitHub API rate limits.
